title: The Secret of the Turtle Shell
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng's gaze was deep and profound, as if wanting to speak yet hesitating, hinting that he knew the origin of the turtle shell

text.content: Deep night. On the dilapidated wooden bed in the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters, Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes. A burning heat radiated from his palm—the turtle shell that had accompanied him for seventeen years was emitting a faint glow. He held his breath, examining it carefully under the moonlight streaming through the window. Within the cracks on the turtle shell's surface, pale azure threads of light flowed slowly, like living creatures. Seventeen years. For as long as he could remember, this turtle shell had never shown any reaction. He had countless times clutched it in his hand, trying to feel the warmth left by his father, only to receive cold, rough texture in return. And tonight, it was as if a giant beast sleeping for ten thousand years had finally opened its eyes.

Chen Ji made no rash movements. He slowly sat up, holding the turtle shell beneath the moonlight for a careful observation. The flowing light threads seemed to respond to his gaze, each beam of light telling of some long-buried secret. He forced himself to remain calm. After years of playing the role of atrash in the cultivation world, he had long since learned to observe first, judge second, and act last whenever faced with the unusual. Impulsiveness had always been the privilege of the weak. The turtle shell's glow gradually stabilized, no longer flickering, yet not completely extinguished either. Chen Ji could sense the temperature in his palm steadily climbing, as if something was awakening from slumber.

Chen Ji was only six years old when his father disappeared. In his vague memories, his father Chen Xuan had once been a prominent figure in the Tianqing Sect, yet vanished one night without a trace, leaving only this turtle shell and a vaguely-worded instruction: "Ji'er, no matter what happens, don't let anyone know about this thing's existence." He had countless times pondered the deeper meaning behind his father's words. Tianqing Sect servant,trash disciple,spat upon by all—over these years, he had turned himself into a拙劣 performance, while the turtle shell remained the hidden trump card deepest within his costume. Only he had never expected this trump card to finally reveal itself tonight.

dialogue.content: Father, what exactly did you leave behind?

text.content: Chen Ji murmured softly, his voice as faint as a whisper. He flipped the turtle shell over, examining it carefully under the moonlight—a very shallow pattern was carved on its back. Had it not been glowing, it would have been almost impossible to detect with the naked eye. The pattern seemed chaotic at first glance, yet possessed a subtle underlying order, like some ancient script or a formation inscription. Just as he was carefully observing it, a faint pulsation suddenly emanated from within the turtle shell. Thump. Thump. Thump. Like a heartbeat, or like some ancient calling.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, gathering a thread of weak spiritual energy at his fingertip. He carefully channeled the spiritual energy into the turtle shell—the next instant, the pale azure light threads erupted violently, illuminating the entire Servants' Quarters as bright as day.

choices.description: First suppress one's aura, observe the turtle shell's subsequent reactions
choices.risk_hint: The turtle shell's reaction may have a time limit; missing the optimal timing

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his finger, suppressing the trembling in his heart. He clutched the turtle shell in his palm, shielding its glow with his body, while carefully listening for any movements in the surroundings. Years of concealment had taught him—any anomaly could be a precursor to danger.

Just then, soft footsteps sounded from outside the door. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He swiftly stuffed the turtle shell into his怀中, flipped back onto the bed, and pulled the blanket up to his chin, disguising himself as an ordinary Servant Disciple who had been startled awake by a nightmare. The door was gently pushed open, and a hunched silhouette appeared in the moonlight. It was Mo Xiansheng. That mysterious existence who existed as a remnant soul on the first page of the Tianji Record, who knew all the truths of the Tianji Record yet only revealed "what should be said"—the guardian of the chessboard.

dialogue.content: "It's so late, why aren't you asleep?"

text.content: Chen Ji sat up from the bed, wearing his usual timid expression: "Reporting to Master, the disciple just had a nightmare and couldn't fall back asleep." Mo Xiansheng walked slowly into the room, his murky gaze lingering on Chen Ji for a moment before shifting to the spot where Chen Ji had been lying. Chen Ji could feel the other's gaze like something tangible, as if it would pierce through every pore of his body. A faint spiritual energy fluctuation lingered in the air—that was the residual aura of the turtle shell. Chen Ji's heart tightened, though his expression remained undisturbed. He knew Mo Xiansheng had already sensed something.

dialogue.content: "Is that so? This old one just sensed a peculiar spiritual energy fluctuation and thought some senior was cultivating at night."

dialogue.content: "This disciple did feel some heat in the palm just now, perhaps due to being too impatient with cultivation recently..."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, a mysterious smile forming on his withered face. He did not press further, merely walking slowly to the window and gazing at the cold waning moon in the night sky. "Chen Ji, do you know that some things in this world are beyond the reach of ordinary people? Some inheritances require waiting; some destinies require fate. Your father back then..." At this point, Mo Xiansheng suddenly paused. He turned his head, a strange gleam flickering in his murky eyes, as if wanting to say something, yet forcibly holding back.

dialogue.content: "Never mind, heavenly secrets must not be revealed. You only need to remember—the turtle shell is far more ancient than you imagine. Its choice to awaken at this moment must have its reasons."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart was shaken. Mo Xiansheng actually knew about the turtle shell's existence! He tried to control his expression, allowing no surprise or wariness to leak out. Over these years, he had carefully concealed the turtle shell, never displaying its anomaly before anyone. And tonight, with just one faint reaction, this mysterious remnant soul guardian had already detected it. How much did Mo Xiansheng actually know? What kind of connection existed between him and Chen Ji's father?

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, merely quietly gazing at Mo Xiansheng. He was waiting—waiting for the other side to voluntarily show more of their cards. Sometimes, silence draws out more secrets than questioning.

Mo Xiansheng's gaze lingered on Chen Ji's face for a long while, as if examining something. After a moment, he let out a soft sigh, a sigh that seemed to contain too many indescribable things. "You and your father... are truly alike." These words made Chen Ji's heart tremble. His father had disappeared when Chen Ji was only six; his memories were already blurred. Yet hearing such words from someone who knew all the truths of the Tianji Record carried undeniable weight. Mo Xiansheng turned toward the door, his hunched back appearing especially aged beneath the moonlight.

dialogue.content: "Take good care of it. Someday, you will understand everything. But before that... don't let anyone know."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's figure vanished into the night. Chen Ji sat alone on the bed, the now-peaceful turtle shell tucked in his怀中. Its temperature was slowly fading, yet that lingering pulsating sensation remained in his palm, like some silent promise. "Don't let anyone know." His father had instructed him the same way all those years ago. But now, even the guardian of the Tianji Record knew about the turtle shell's existence. What did this mean? Coincidence, or... was everything under the manipulation of some invisible hand? He slowly closed his eyes, pressing the turtle shell against his lower abdomen, feeling that final trace of warmth. No matter what, he finally knew one thing—this turtle shell was by no means ordinary. And his father's disappearance back then was likely far more complex than he had imagined. The faint heartbeat within the turtle shell continued, as if waiting for something. Chen Ji took a deep breath and tucked it back into his怀中. He knew that from this night forward, another new piece had been added to his chessboard. And this piece's weight might even exceed the Tianji Record itself.
